visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length black hair is sitting in the driver's seat of a stationary car. She is wearing a brown suede coat with white shearling trim and a cream-colored turtleneck. She looks directly into the lens, talking with active facial expressions. Outside the car window, leafless trees and a bright, overcast sky are visible. (2) The woman reaches down and pulls out a sleek, black circular compact case with a silver rose emblem on the lid. She opens it to reveal a mirror and a light pink pressed powder inside. She uses a small black puff to gently rub the surface of the powder in a circular motion. (3) The scene cuts to a medium close-up as she applies the powder to her face, focusing on her nose and cheek area. On-screen text appears on the left side of the frame, showing comparisons between treated and untreated skin. The lighting is bright and even within the car cabin. (4) The camera shifts to an extreme close-up of the compact. A finger swatches the light pink powder, demonstrating its fine texture. The rose pattern in the powder is clearly visible. (5) The setting transitions to an outdoor snowy environment at dusk or dawn. The sun is low on the horizon, casting an orange glow through bare trees. The woman is walking while holding the camera in a selfie perspective, showing her face after several hours of wear. (6) Finally, the scene moves to a brightly lit indoor living room. The woman holds two different compacts—one with white powder and one with pink. She applies each to a different side of her face to compare the color-correcting effects, pointing to her cheeks and forehead.
